thread:
jen: FYI Elaine submitted a resignation this morning. Last day is 2026-06-04. Need to align benefits cutoff, COBRA timeline, IT access removal, and equipment return. @rachel can you confirm benefits end date?

rachel: Yes — active coverage runs through 2026-06-30 (end of month). We'll generate the COBRA packet on the first business day after final payroll. Expect packet around 2026-06-08. I'll include the enrollment link and the 60-day election window.

dean: On IT side, propose deprovision on 2026-06-04 at 17:00 PT. Sequence: disable SSO, remove Okta sessions, revoke AWS console keys, remove GitHub org membership, disable Slack. Any owned infra keys? @elaine please list.

elaine: I own terraform state access and one deploy key: `tf-deploy-elaine`. Also `ci-token-elaine` for our CI. I'll transfer state permissions to @kevin and rotate the deploy key before 6/4 morning.

kevin: I'll accept the TF handoff and verify state locking. @dean please hold revocation of CI token until I confirm the new token works.

dean: Will wait for confirmation. Tentative deprovision commands (internal):
```
/tools/deprov --user elaine --step disable-sso
/tools/deprov --user elaine --step revoke-github
/tools/deprov --user elaine --step revoke-aws-keys
/tools/deprov --user elaine --step disable-slack
```

it-bot: Reminder: scheduled oncall conflict detected. Elaine is on rotation 2026-06-04 evening. Reassign before deprovision.

jen: Reassigning oncall to @kevin for 2026-06-04 night. Do not remove pagerduty until 2026-06-04 20:00 PT so Kevin can validate.

ops-bot: Note added to runbook: `oncall/owners` updated with temporary assignment.

rachel: Final paycheck will be pro-rated through 6/04 and include payout for unused PTO per policy. COBRA packet will state coverage effective date starts 2026-07-01 if elected.

jen: Equipment return — laptop + power + dock. Option A: ship via courier with prepaid label (pickup 6/08-6/10). Option B: drop at SF office. Which does Elaine prefer?

elaine: Courier pickup is best. I'll confirm serial SN: LPT-3344, Dock DK-77.

kevin: For monitoring/alerting, I'll rotate any incident keys after handoff. Please leave a note in the alert runbook `alerts/owners.md`.

dean: One more thing: please ensure external service integrations (Sentry, Datadog) have no lingering personal tokens. @elaine can you scan for personal tokens in last 6 months?

elaine: Will scan tonight and open PRs to replace tokens with team accounts.

jen: Summary checklist: benefits active through 6/30; COBRA packet ~6/08; final check pro-rated to 6/04 with PTO payout; IT deprov 6/04 17:00 PT (hold pager until 20:00 PT); TF state transfer to Kevin; CI token rotation confirmation before deprov; equipment courier pickup 6/08-6/10; exit interview scheduling. Any blockers?

elaine: No blockers. Please schedule a 30m exit interview with People Ops.

rachel: Setting up exit interview for 6/02 at 10:00 PT — invite sent.

jen: Thanks team. I'll close this thread once IT confirms deprovision complete and courier scheduled.
